subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Centaur Between Worlds
description: A quick win: understand The Centaur Between Worlds.

hook.text: Half-human, half-horse. Centaurs drank, fought, and ran wild. They embodied the animal inside every person.

buildup.text: Most centaurs were savage. But Chiron was wise—a teacher of heroes. Even among beasts, one can transcend.

discovery.text: Chiron taught Achilles, Asclepius, and Jason. The greatest heroes were trained by a creature between two natures.

twist.text: Centaurs may originate from nomadic horsemen. People who seemed fused to horses were mythologized as monsters.

climax.text: The centaur is the human condition: civilized above, animal below. The hybrid is the truth we don't admit.

quiz.question: What made Chiron different from other centaurs?
options: He was wise and taught heroes
